pages.mainText: Software solutions that simplify the way you work Connecting each stage of your supply chain journey, unlocking the data your business needs to excel. End-to-End Supply Chain Management Software for Food Safety, Compliance, Procurement and CSR Book a demo Unlock the benefits of a digitised supply chain Mitigate RiskOur supply chain management software helps to mitigate risk with a standardised approach to data collection and management. This reduces the likelihood of human error or incomplete data while also streamlining key administrative processes. 360° VisibilityYour data is stored in a centralised location to ensure transparency, visibility and accountability across your team and your business, even across multiple sites. With a 360-degree view of your supply chain teams can access real-time insights and make informed and proactive decisions based on data. Automate WorkflowsFinally, digitising your supply chain with Foods Connected means that you can automate manual processes and reporting, reducing unnecessary admin so teams can focus on value-added tasks. Automated notifications and reminders streamline supplier management and identify issues at-a-glance. Learn More VIDEO Our Food Supply Chain Software Discover more about Foods Connected and how we can help your business in 60 seconds! SOFTWARE solutions Our Technology Our configurable software solutions come complete as a full suite for full control from one hub, or, you can select just the solutions that your business needs right now, all connected together. You can also easily integrate with other leading systems you may be using to manage specific areas. Plus add on additional solutions at any time! Food Compliance SoftwareAudit and optimise your food supply chain for improved compliance and reduced risk. Discover More Safety Audits & Quality ManagementGuarantee compliance across the supply chain with quality checks, risk assessments and structured workflows. Discover More Food Procurement Management SoftwareEnhance procurement with clear forecasting, order management and trend analysis. Discover More Food Specifications & NPDManage and share specification data across all food types for collaborative product development. Discover More CSR & Supply Chain SustainabilityUse data-driven insights to fortify CSR efforts and help raise the bar on sustainability in the food industry. Discover More Food Traceability SoftwareGet a complete understanding of the entire product supply chain with innovative blockchain technology. Discover More Reporting &AnalyticsConnect insights across your entire range of products with data from your supply chain the wider food industry. Discover More OUR SERVICES Supply Chain Insight & Expertise Working with our highly skilled team of food industry professionals, gain an understanding of where you are currently and where you want to get to with your supply chain and internal processes. INCLUDES: Exploratory Focus Sessions Complete Industry Expertise Project Management Specialists Live Expert Support Team Learn More WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS SAY "With Foods Connected we were able to streamline our communications with our suppliers and eliminate over-use of emails. We could build a dashboard to pull data directly from suppliers responses, easily identifying our sustainability leaders in our supply chain." Emma Daly Sustainability Supply Chain Manager, OSI "Using Foods Connected has allowed us to drive standard processes across our business, helping capture data in a consistent way meaning the analytics allows us to easily see comparable performance on any level." Nick Gollins Technical Controller, Ornua "We needed a global solution to manage our expansive supply chain and improve transparency across every tier. Foods Connected delivered integrated tools that enhance visibility, track supplier compliance, and help mitigate potential risks." Simon Rose Head of Purchasing and Inventory, Marley Spoon "We've been able to make decisions based on live supply chain data - something we never had before. In terms of impact, going up a tier in our BBFAW impact rating is something we couldn't have done without the system." Ellie Wotherspoon Food and Beverage Sourcing Manager, Whitbread "Foods Connected’s software unlocks the data we need for full supply chain transparency, boosting efficiency, FSMA 204 readiness, and our ability to deliver the best foods at great value - the recipe to our success for the past 50 years." Mark Earnest Vice President of Quality Assurance, Captain D's "The Foods Connected platform has allowed us to simplify, standardise and collate all our product data across a multitude of suppliers meaning we have access to the data we need as we need it. Laura Robinson Head of Technical, Finnebrogue Companies We Work With 1 Retailers & Food Service Providers A one stop shop to manage all elements of your food supply chain to help deliver optimal cost of goods whilst ensuring maximum transparency on supplier compliance and product quality whilst gaining insight into your supply chain on delivery of CSR goals. Learn More 2 LARGE MANUFACTURERS Build up a suite of cost-effective solutions to complement your ERP system in one place. Capture and manage a wide range of information internally within your business ensuring everyone is using the same data whilst communicating with suppliers and customers in a single system. Learn More 3 SME’S Select one or two solutions to digitise data capture and reporting in your food business processes to save significant wasted time and cost on pen & paper and spreadsheets Learn More FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS Supply Chain Management What are the main benefits of Foods Connected for the supply chain? Foods Connected simplifies the food supply chain by optimising spend and unlocking the data that food manufacturers, retailers and distributors need to excel. Our tools make it as easy as possible for our customers to manage and report on supply chain traceability, product lifecycle management, procurement, food safety and quality control and sustainability. Can Foods Connected help manage and improve supply chains outside of the food industry? While our technology is designed primarily to help food industry businesses, it can be used by anyone who wants to improve their supply chain solutions. One of the main selling points of our software is that it is adaptable; not only can we cater to the needs of specific teams such as procurement or technology, we also deliver the added benefit of bringing siloed data together across departments and sites into a single source of truth. This improves supply chain visibility by facilitating collaboration and helps customers make better business-wide decisions. How can I get my suppliers using Foods Connected? Foods Connected’s supply chain management platform is both simple and user-friendly for both customers and suppliers. For suppliers, one of the key benefits is removing duplicated effort and admin, with data such as SAQs, Specs or standards and certifications like BRC, Red Tractor, GMP, HACCP, ISO 22000, or SQFI only needing to be managed once. The software also has built-in automated reminders and triggers to encourage engagement by all stakeholders to your business. Solutions Providing you with the tools to become a more successful and sustainable business. Supplier Compliance Quality Management Product Lifecycle Management Procurement Sustainability Solutions Optimise Track & Trace Trends & Insights Supplier Compliance Manage your supply chain risk with transparency and real-time compliance Foods Connected makes maintaining supplier compliance easy, reducing risk and improving relationships. Our software enables you to streamline supplier onboarding, simplify supplier risk management, and automate compliance tracking all in one place, ensuring suppliers always meet your business requirements. Quality Management Improve product quality and eradicate visibility issues with our integrated system Our quality management solutions provide real-time quality insights, so you can audit, check, risk assess and log incidents to improve product quality throughout your supply chain. With Foods Connected, you can maintain quality consistency, while optimising production and minimising waste. Product Lifecycle Management Manage product specifications, optimise critical paths and automate workflows Our product lifecycle management solutions keep you ahead of the competition. They accelerate innovation and unblock bottlenecks, keeping your NPD moving, so you can bring your products to market faster and maintain accurate controls on product specifications in real time. Procurement Achieve cost-of-goods saving with this time-efficient bird’s-eye view of your entire procurement process Our efficient flexible solutions are designed as a tool set for procurement teams to confidently manage procurement supply chains, streamlining process, while reducing risk and cost. With this one source of truth providing assured continuity, you can automate procurement processes, manage negotiations, orders and contracts, and streamline your service level to the customer, guaranteeing reduced end-to-end costs of between 2-10%. Sustainability Solutions Stay socially and environmentally responsible with our expert services and data-driven insights Foods Connected solutions are designed to address the bigger sustainability and governance picture, supporting your initiatives and improving your supply chain transparency. We advise on on-site solutions, inform on policy developments and share industry insights, while our software empowers you to measure and reduce your environmental impact and monitor supplier sustainability, all the while driving growth and profitability. Optimise Track and trend your production process critical path with profitable results Foods Connected helps you achieve cost of goods savings through better data modelling. We work with your business to give you clarity across your entire production process, making sense of the cost dynamics that make up your products. Using our solutions, you can balance the components of your supply chain budgets, boosting yields and reducing volatility, to establish a more sustainable and efficient cost model. Track & Trace Digitally connect and trace your entire supply chain for brand peace of mind Foods Connected helps you achieve cost of goods savings through better data modelling. We work with your business to give you clarity across your entire production process, making sense of the cost dynamics that make up your products. Using our solutions, you can balance the components of your supply chain budgets, boosting yields and reducing volatility, to establish a more sustainable and efficient cost model. Trends & Insights Make better business decisions with our data-led reporting solutions We know processing large amounts of data can be slow and time-consuming. That’s why our intelligent reporting solutions do the hard work for you, so you can quickly identify the key metrics and experience the tangible benefits. Our actionable insights reduce costs, drive growth and promote responsibility, helping your business remain ahead of the competition. What our customers say "Connected has provided the framework to capture agreed sales & purchasing outcomes in one centralised location. This enables ease of comparison on all best price options for more informed business decisions.” Graham Spicer Operations and Business Manager, Woolworths "Since partnering with Foods Connected we have been able to rapidly streamline our supplier management processes and enhance our data collection. The system is really easy to use and is having a positive impact on ourselves and our suppliers.” Ashleigh Horn Responsible Sourcing Manager, Cook Food "Connected has helped Marley Spoon to document, review and improve all our supplier data and performance, enabling efficient and effective decision-making based on real-time data." Simon

pages.mainText: About Us Learn more aboutFoods Connected Discover more in 90 seconds About Us Why Foods Connected is born out of our passion for solving problems and maximising opportunities within the Food Industry. As a team we believe in improving efficiency and simplifying tasks wherever possible to make for a happier, more productive team. It’s what gets us up in the morning. How? We collaborate with our customers to understand the changing problems and opportunities that the food industry faces and develop innovative ideas and simple solutions based off this to deliver real value in the industry. What? We innovate & transform food supply chain processes through our one-stop shop software solution that gives our customers the control to ensure that they have the right supplier, the right product and the right quality at the best price possible. We deliver increased control & visibility for our customers in the simplest way possible. Sectors Mission & Vision As a team, we are 100% committed to the principle of simplicity. Working in the food industry can be complicated and our aim is to improve and simplify our customers’ lives through the deployment of world class software, useful informative reporting and best in class food industry insight, coupled with expert guidance. We believe we can make a difference to people’s lives and livelihoods, by enriching the lives of our colleagues through clear communication, engagement and purpose. We also believe in giving back a part of our talents, energy and funds to create a sustainable business with an eye to the future. To aid our local community we have partnered with FareShare Northern Ireland and Foyle Food Bank to improve food poverty and food security in Northern Ireland. We also hold various charity events throughout the year for other organisations, as voted for by our employees. Our vision is to continuously improve and develop our software solutions with a maintained emphasis on customer satisfaction and user experience. We want to keep helping the food industry to simplify it’s processes. We will continue to work with our industry partners and customers to drive our product offering forward and ensure what you get is what you need. As we continue to grow, we will focus further on bringing our software to the global market so that even more food companies can benefit and enjoy the difference that Foods Connected has to offer. Sectors Meet some of the Team JAMESSOFTWARE DEVELOPER When not working as System Developer for Foods Connected, he can be found watching a Liverpool match, cycling, travelling, reading a good fact book or enjoying an evening in front of the TV catching up on a good series. NICHOLASHEAD OF SALES & PARTNERSHIPS AUSTRALIA & NZ With a passion for innovation and over 15 years in retail, Nicholas found his calling at Foods Connected When not engaging with fresh produce growers, Nicholas can be found on the long training path to ascend Mt Everest. LIAMSYSTEMS DEVELOPER Adrenaline Junkie who spends most of his weekends covered in dirt at the motocross track or mountain bike trails. When he’s not hanging on for dear life on a dirt bike, he likes stay active in the gym, work on cars, bikes and travel to obscure hidden gems of the world, oh and to try as much new cuisine as possible (Can’t forget about the food!) JILLPROJECT LEAD & CLIENT DEVELOPMENT MANAGER An animal lover who frequently competes on the showjumping circuit across Ireland, when not travelling to meet our lovely clients, she can be found in the outdoors enjoying nature, or assisting vets on call. CATHALSYSTEMS DEVELOPER A graduate from the Letterkenny Institute of Technology , with a degree in Applied Computing. In his free time he’ll usually be at the gym or trying to play golf. Big sports fan -especially football (Liverpool fan), he loves having a few pints in a pub somewhere whilst watching the games. JENQUALITY & TECHNICAL PROJECT LEAD When she’s not working, Jen loves to travel and see new places, 40 countries visited and counting. She also does sports event volunteering, everything from small scale local charity 10k runs up to international events, last year she was out in Australia for the Commonwealth Games. FOODS CONNECTED Our Values Our values are what drive our business forward and get us up and raring to go in the morning. Here at Foods Connected we believe in keeping things simple, so we have 3 simple values which as a team we stand by and which bring us together to keep on developing great solutions. Simplicity 1 2 Service Innovation 3 FOODS CONNECTED World & Community Wide. Food businesses of all sizes globally trust us to help keep their finger on the pulse of their business. Over 8,000 suppliers are currently using Foods Connected to communicate with their customers around the world. EMAIL NEWSLETTER Keep ahead of the curve. Subscribe to our newsletter and keep up to date on the latest food industry news delivered directly to your inbox.
